title: Two Contacts in Series (AND Logic)
story: Safety press requirement: A stamping press must only cycle when the operator presses BOTH hand buttons simultaneously to keep their hands safe.
concept: Contacts wired in series form an AND function. Both contacts must conduct for power to reach the load.

learn.title: Series = AND
learn.text: When contacts are connected end-to-end in line, current must pass through all of them. If any contact is open, power stops.

tests.name: Both buttons required to operate press

steps.explanation: Only PB1 pressed: PRESS must NOT run.
Only PB2 pressed: PRESS must NOT run.
Both PB1 and PB2 pressed: PRESS runs!

hints: Wire PB1's right terminal to PB2's left terminal (in series).
Wire PB2's right terminal to PRESS, then PRESS to Rail R.
